name: Battle Arena (CWC04)
author: Zhiu_1234
description:
This game is based on the CWC Live prototype 4, but it has some extras:

- Basic movement (space = jump. vertical movement for speed control, horizontal movement for camera control)
- Three unique power-ups: Shockwave jump, auto-aim bullets and power tackle
- Normal, aggressive and boss enemies
- Each boss has an additional ability: spawning additional enemies, firing homing missiles at player, or agile jumps
- The game counts the waves and at wave 4, 6 and 10, boss enemies will spawn
- Postprocessing effects
- Cheat button "R" will reset the player back to the platform
Try to finish all waves and be victorious (without using "R"). Have fun! :)
